title: Big Bold Fruity Mango Passion 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Fruity Shortfill Mango Passion brings together the rich, tropical sweetness of mango with the tangy, exotic flavour of passionfruit. This smooth and vibrant e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy exotic fruit blends, delivering a burst of fruity flavour with every vape. The Big Bold Shortfill range is blended with a 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, making it ideal for sub-ohm vaping and high-powered vape kits. Each 100ml bottle comes with 20ml of extra space for the addition of two nicotine shots to tailor your e-liquid's strength to your preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. If you're a fan of tropical flavours, there are several other exciting blends to discover in Big Bold’s Fruity collection, including Blackcurrant, Honey Melon, and Lemon Lime. Explore the world of Big Bold and enjoy the perfect balance of flavour and vapour production with every puff.
